children: On 3 September 2026, Berner Industrier announced that the Board of Directors had initiated a strategic review regarding the subsidiary Bullerbekämparen Svenska AB (Bullerbekämparen) to evaluate possible alternatives for the company. The review has now led to Berner Industrier, through a subsidiary, entered into an agreement and today completed a divestment of all shares in Bullerbekämparen to Reuterwall Holding AB.

Bullerbekämparen is active in sound-dampening products and solutions, including in industry. The buyer is the majority owner of Industridraperier i Örebro AB, with a complementary range. Together, the two companies intend to create a stronger whole in Nordic noise reduction.

Bullerbekämparen was one of the Group's smallest companies and had sales of SEK 26 million in 2025, with a weak result. The company has been part of Berner Industrier's Energy & Environment business area. The transaction is expected to have only a marginal impact on the Group's sales and earnings.
Henrik Nordin, CFO and deputy CEO, +46 8-501 567 90

Berner Industrier is a Nordic industrial group in sustainable technology that operates in a number of attractive and growing niche markets. The Group offers innovative products and solutions that help solve the challenges of our societies through technology. Key areas include clean energy, clean water and sustainable use of resources. The Group consists of nine companies that together have about 250 employees across the Nordic region and annual revenues of about SEK 1,000 million. Berner Industrier was founded in 1897 and has been listed on Nasdaq Stockholm Main Market since 2017. The share’s ticker symbol is BERNER. Read more about us at bernerindustrier.se.

title: Berner Industrier has divested Bullerbekämparen
